declarations.description:
A scroll container with themed scrollbars and edge shadows, like the ScrollArea of Mantine, Chakra and PrimeVue and
the side panels of Slack and Linear. Scrolling stays native (wheel, touch, keys, momentum, scroll snapping), so it
keeps the platform's feel; the scrollbar is themed through CSS (`scrollbar-width`, `scrollbar-color`, and the
WebKit pseudo-elements), and its thumb can fade in only while the pointer is over the area.

A shadow shows on each edge with content hidden behind it, and disappears once that edge is reached, so a list at
its top has no shadow above it. Set the shadow colour to `transparent` to turn shadows off, or a fade size above 0 to
fade the content into the edges instead. `orientation` picks the axes that scroll.

The region has a tab stop and a name (`label`), because a region that scrolls must be reachable by keyboard.
`scroll-edge` fires when a scroll reaches an edge: the hook for loading more in a feed or a chat. `viewport` is the
element that scrolls, for code that needs the real scroller; `scrollToEdge()` jumps to an edge.

`controls` turns the area into a row scroller: a button over each edge with more beyond it scrolls most of a page
towards that edge, and hides once the edge is reached. The buttons are for the pointer: they are named but kept out
of the tab order, because the area itself is the tab stop and its arrow and page keys already scroll it.
`scrollPage()` is what they call, for an app's own buttons. `mouse-drag` lets a mouse drag the content to scroll it,
as touch does natively; the click that ends a drag does not reach a link or a button in the content.

cssProperties.description: The tallest the area grows before it scrolls.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area--max-height

cssProperties.description: The scrollbar's thickness where it can be set (WebKit).
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__scrollbar--size

cssProperties.description: The thumb while the pointer is over the area; with a transparent thumb, the bar fades in on hover.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__thumb__hover--color

cssProperties.description: Width and height of the shadow.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__shadow--size

cssProperties.description: Above 0, the content fades into each edge with more beyond it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__fade--size

cssProperties.description: Width and height of a `controls` button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__control--size

cssProperties.description: Distance from a `controls` button to its edge.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__control--inset

cssProperties.description: Width and height of the control icon.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__control__icon--size

cssProperties.description: Opacity of a shown `controls` button while the pointer is off the area and focus is outside it; `0` shows the buttons only on hover. Ignored on devices that cannot hover.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__control--opacity

cssParts.description: The `controls` button on the top edge, around the `top-icon` slot.
cssParts.name: top-control

cssParts.description: The `controls` button on the bottom edge, around the `bottom-icon` slot.
cssParts.name: bottom-control

cssParts.description: The `controls` button on the inline start edge, around the `start-icon` slot.
cssParts.name: start-control

cssParts.description: The `controls` button on the inline end edge, around the `end-icon` slot.
cssParts.name: end-control

slots.description: Icon of the `controls` button on the top edge. Defaults to a chevron.
slots.name: top-icon

slots.description: Icon of the `controls` button on the bottom edge. Defaults to a chevron.
slots.name: bottom-icon

slots.description: Icon of the `controls` button on the inline start edge. Defaults to a chevron.
slots.name: start-icon

slots.description: Icon of the `controls` button on the inline end edge. Defaults to a chevron.
slots.name: end-icon

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the scroll region.

members.name: controls
members.description: Show a button over each edge with more beyond it, which scrolls most of a page towards that edge.

members.name: mouseDrag
members.description: Let a mouse drag the content to scroll it. Touch scrolls by dragging natively either way.

members.name: beyond
members.default: { top: false, bottom: false, start: false, end: false }
members.description: Edges with content hidden behind them.

members.name: fading
members.description: Whether a fade size is set: the mask is only applied then.

members.name: reached
members.description: Edges reached at the last measure, so `scroll-edge` fires once per arrival.

members.name: measuredOnce
members.description: The first measure records where the area starts without announcing it.

members.name: stopDrag
members.description: Detaches `mouse-drag` (`./mouse-drag.js`, loaded the first time it is on).

members.name: scrollToEdge
members.description: Scrolls to an edge: `top`, `bottom`, or `start` / `end` on the inline axis (which follow the writing direction).

members.name: scrollPage
members.description:
Scrolls most of a page towards an edge, as the `controls` buttons do; `start` / `end` follow the writing direction.
Smooth unless the user prefers reduced motion. Scroll snapping set on the `viewport` part still applies.

members.name: measure
members.description: Works out which edges have content behind them, and fires `scroll-edge` for an edge just reached by a scroll.

events.name: scroll-edge
events.description: Fired when a scroll reaches an edge. Does not bubble, so a scroll area nested in another does not trigger the outer one's listener.
